props.gloss_en: the mishna: a wagon's detachable undercarriage is not joined to it [for impurity, measure and tent]; and one may not drag it on Shabbat while there are coins on it
the halakha follows R' Shimon [on muktze]
R' Yochanan, asked whether a hen's roost may be moved on Shabbat: is it made for anything but hens? [so it may not]
R' Yochanan's roost is one with a dead chick in it
Rava (as Mar bar Ameimar reports): R' Shimon agreed that animals that died are forbidden
Rava (as Mar brei deRav Yosef reports): R' Shimon disagreed even about animals that died -- they are permitted
R' Yochanan's roost is one with an egg [laid on Shabbat] in it
Rav Nachman: whoever holds muktze holds nolad; whoever does not hold muktze does not hold nolad
R' Yochanan's roost is one with an egg containing a chick
the halakha follows R' Yehuda [on muktze]
Rav Yosef: R' Yochanan's 'they said the halakha follows R' Shimon' reports others; he himself does not hold it
Abaye: a candelabrum fell on R' Asi's cloak [at R' Abba of Haifa's house] and he did not move it
Reish Lakish's ruling in Sidon: a candelabrum carried in one hand may be moved
...one carried in two hands may not be moved
R' Yochanan: we have [permission] only for a lamp, per R' Shimon
...but a candelabrum, whether carried in one hand or in two, may not be moved
Rabba and Rav Yosef: [the candelabrum is forbidden] since a person fixes a place for it
a grooms' canopy may be pitched and may be dismantled on Shabbat
Abaye: [the forbidden candelabrum is] one made of joints
'joints' means like joints: it has grooves
a jointed candelabrum, large or small, may not be moved
a large grooved candelabrum too [is forbidden] -- a decree on account of a large jointed one
the reason for the large grooved one: a decree on account of a large jointed one
a small grooved candelabrum: we decree [it forbidden]
a small grooved candelabrum: we do not decree [it is permitted]
R' Yochanan: the halakha follows an anonymous mishna
R' Zeira: let our mishna be where there were no coins on it throughout twilight -- so as not to break R' Yochanan's words
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: once Rabbi went to Dyosfera and ruled on a candelabrum like R' Shimon on a lamp
Rav Malkiya, at R' Simlai's house, moved a lamp, and R' Simlai was annoyed
R' Yosei Gelilaa, in R' Yosei bar Chanina's place, moved a lamp, and R' Yosei bar Chanina was annoyed
R' Abbahu, in R' Yehoshua ben Levi's place, would move a lamp
...in R' Yochanan's place he would not move a lamp
R' Abbahu in fact holds like R' Shimon
...and out of respect for R' Yochanan he did not act on it

questions.gloss_en: איבעיא להו: did Rabbi rule on the candelabrum like R' Shimon on the lamp -- to permit it? or did he rule on the candelabrum to forbid, and [separately] like R' Shimon on the lamp to permit? תיקו

supports.gloss_en: ואת לא תסברה דרבי יוחנן כרבי יהודה? R' Asi did not move the candelabrum that fell on his cloak -- לאו משום דרבי אסי תלמידיה דרבי יוחנן הוה, ורבי יוחנן כרבי יהודה סבירא ליה

deflected_by.gloss_en: מנרתא קאמרת? מנרתא שאני -- for the candelabrum R' Yochanan forbids even on R' Shimon's view (p_ry_menora_asur)

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי? והא בעא מיניה ההוא סבא: a hen's roost -- may it be moved? כלום עשוי אלא לתרנגולין!

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא במאי עסקינן -- דאית ביה אפרוח מת (= p_kina_efroach_met)

objections.gloss_en: הניחא למר בר אמימר משמיה דרבא (R' Shimon agreed about dead animals); אלא למר בריה דרב יוסף משמיה דרבא (he disagreed even there), מאי איכא למימר?

אמר ליה אביי לרב יוסף: והרי כילת חתנים דאדם קובע לו מקום, ואמר שמואל משום רבי חייא: it may be pitched and dismantled on Shabbat! Unanswered: אלא אמר אביי (46a.1)

answered_by.gloss_en: מאי חוליות -- כעין חוליות, דאית בה חידקי (= p_kein_chulyot); they differ only over a small grooved one

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי? והאמר רבי יוחנן הלכה כסתם משנה (p_halakha_kistam_mishna), ותנן: the undercarriage... while coins are on it -- so without coins permitted, though they were on it at twilight (46a.4)

objections.gloss_en: מה נפשך? אי כרבי יהודה סבירא ליה -- ליעבד כרבי יהודה; אי כרבי שמעון סבירא ליה -- ליעבד כרבי שמעון! -- R' Abbahu's practice differs by place
